n0.text: Come closer, dearie. Granny Edam has seen a hundred harvests and sniffed ninety-nine cheeses.

n1.text: The Cheese Cave runs deeper than the hill. The Last Wheel was kept in the Aging Hall, behind a door that only opens for those who know the Three Cuts.

n2.text: Take Madame Brie, that grand hen in the orchard, she hears the winds. Take Clover, the goat in the pasture, she is a wall of iron. And Maple, my granddaughter, she keeps the cellar. Go. Find them!
